svg.title: ScrapC progress
svg.text: State of 2026-11-12. Percentages are estimates, steps weighted by their share of the work.
1. Recreation in CThe engine and game code of Scrap.exe as C, weight 30
2. Clean C codeReadable code without the decompilation scaffolding, weight 10
3. Modern renderer and mediaVulkan, FFmpeg and an own sound mixer, weight 10
4. Linux and 64 bitNative builds for Linux and Windows, weight 10
5. Python scripts in C (issue #2)The game's Python 1.5.2 scripts as C and data files, weight 25
6. Free-roam multiplayer (issue #1)Players meet on the open map, weight 15
Engine and game functions in C
every function of the game range is C
ScrapC runs without Scrap.exe or a hook DLL
tables and strings are typed C data
hooks, rva macros and exactness code removed
English names, merged structs and types
Ghidra project not yet updated to the new names
display modes and lasso confirmed; gamepad, mouse, Alt-Tab untested
all 29 levels start clean under ASan
menus, HUD, characters, missions; Xbox menus and dev tools skipped
all 263 level scripts are C or data
Ffa and the seven modes, checked with a real server and client
29 levels, 107 mission starts, full campaign; 90% line coverage
interpreter and build option gone (tag interp-final)
all native C up to the last step: Python out of the build
decisions made: sandbox, factions, coop, new protocol
the old PvP modes work as before
